messages:
alice.m: Quick sync — I'm assembling the compliance inventory for the upcoming SOC2/ISO review. Need to lock owners for two pieces: 1) audit-log retention/evidence pipeline, 2) KMS/HSM integration + key rotation playbook. Can owners confirm by EOD today?

bob_k: @alice.m what retention window do we need to certify for SOC2? 90 days or 1 year?

alice.m: SOC2 wants 1 year of accessible audit logs; ISO scope prefers the same. For the audit pipeline we need owner for the ingestion job and owner for artifacts (S3 bucket + manifest).

carlos-l: I can own the KMS/HSM integration work (integration tests, attestation docs). I'll need infra help for HSM provisioning and firmware checks.

frank-infra: @carlos-l noted. Infra dependency: HSM firmware baseline + HSM ACLs + PR infra#2345 to expose BYOK API. ETA for provisioning is Thurs if no blockers. Ticket INFRA-987.

dana-security: For evidence artifacts, let's standardize on s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/<service>/ and a JSON manifest per release. Devs should run this command to upload: ```
aws s3 cp evidence.json s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/service-x/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

dana-security: Also need someone to own the manifest schema and a small validator script (python). Who can pick that up? :eyes:

bob_k: I can take the validator script (small PR). Will open PR against infra-utils today and ping for review.

eva-legal: FYI — we'll need a short cert text about key custody for HSMs (BYOK vs Redwood-managed). If you plan BYOK, legal needs docs on customer responsibilities.

carlos-l: Noted @eva-legal. For now plan is Redwood-managed keys for SOC2 base scope; BYOK flagged as optional later. I'll draft the custody statement.

bob_k: quick Q about audit log query — where should SRE/eng run on-demand pulls? Cloud logging console or direct BigQuery?

frank-infra: We push logs to GCS + BigQuery nightly. On-demand pulls: BigQuery is canonical. Example query we recommend to reviewers: ```SELECT * FROM `redwood-prod.audit_logs` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 365 DAY) AND service = 'auth' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000;```

alice.m: Great. Summarizing action items: 1) Audit ingestion owner + artifacts owner (alice -> assign?) 2) Validator script PR -> @bob_k (ETA EOD) 3) HSM/KMS integration owner -> @carlos-l (coord with @frank-infra, INFRA-987) 4) Legal custody text -> @eva-legal (draft by Fri) 5) Evidence bucket path + manifest schema -> @dana-security (to post schema by EOD).

bob_k: pinging for code review: I'll open PR #4867 in a few minutes and ping reviewers @frank-infra and @alice.m :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy 2026.03.14-88 started by frank-infra — rolling infra change: expose BYOK API (canary 10%)

alice.m: Thanks all. If owners can drop a one-liner confirming here I'm going to paste into the project tracker. If anyone needs to reassign, say so. :+1:

carlos-l: Confirmed — I own KMS/HSM integration and the attestation docs. Will sync with infra tomorrow 10am PT.

dana-security: Confirmed — will post manifest schema and example by EOD and link to checklist.

bob_k: Confirmed — validator script PR coming shortly.

eva-legal: Confirmed — I'll draft custody text and send to @alice.m for review by Fri.

alice.m: Perfect — I'll update the tracker (PROJ-COMP-12) and tag these folks as owners. Thanks everyone!
